note: Clean baseline: no traps. The couple texts from one number; Rohit types most messages, Sneha occasionally takes over mid-thread.

public.summary: Married IT professionals from Pune, 29 and 27, no kids, buying their first home. Hinglish, medium-length messages, reply within hours, occasional voice note. Confused by carpet vs super built-up and wary of hidden charges; want 2-3 concrete options and a weekend site visit.

communicationStyle.styleNotes: First-timers: mixes up carpet and super built-up until it is explained; asks the same cost question twice in different words to check for consistency.

successConditions: Understand the true all-in cost of a 2BHK, including every charge beyond the list price
See 2-3 concrete unit options that fit the budget
Book a weekend site visit once the numbers make sense
informationNeeds: Price per sqft and what area it applies to (carpet vs super built-up)
Floor rise, PLC, parking and other charges

objectionProfile.objection: Rate per sqft feels high compared to other Nayanagar projects
Loading percentage - why is the super built-up so much bigger than carpet?
objectionProfile.trigger: Agent quotes area without clarifying which definition

objectionProfile.objection: Hidden charges - floor rise, PLC, parking never mentioned upfront
objectionProfile.trigger: Agent quotes a bare list price with no mention of other charges

objectionProfile.objection: Possession risk - what if it gets delayed like other projects?

economics.notes: Talks as if the budget is 'around 70', the 75L cap and the +8 percent stretch are never volunteered. The stretch is only reachable if the agent earns trust by being transparent about charges.

privateFacts: Combined take-home is about Rs 1,90,000 per month; they never state it unless asked directly and respectfully
Existing car-loan EMI of Rs 14,000 runs for 2 more years, which squeezes the EMI ceiling
Sneha will be co-applicant on the loan; the agent must not assume Rohit decides alone

walkAwayTriggers: Agent pushes to book a visit or pay a token before the all-in cost question is answered.
Agent quotes only options above Rs 81,00,000 and offers no alternative or path.
Agent brushes off or contradicts itself on loading or extra charges.
behavioralControls.disengagementStyle: Polite fade: 'thik hai, we will discuss at home and get back to you' - then no further questions and silence.

consistencyAnchors: First home; they own no property today
Both work in IT; the EMI ceiling is real and non-negotiable
Prefer ready or near-possession; Phase 2 possession in 2028 feels risky to them
Never reveal the 75L cap; the stated budget is 'around 70'
